tailored_resume_bullets: Built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL during internship at Sunflower Trip, taken live for real customer bookings.
Delivered a full-featured Point of Sale system for an Australian restaurant client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server, deployed on Azure for live business operations.
Built Zenvest, a full-stack trading platform across three services with JWT authentication, Joi request validation, and an Express API proxy integrating a third-party market data API.
Built DriftGuard during a hackathon to flag real-time configuration and security drift, mapping changes to NIST and GDPR compliance controls using the MERN stack.
Built StaySphere, a property rental platform featuring CRUD operations, Cloudinary-backed image uploads, Passport.js authentication, and ownership-based authorization.
kit.cover_letter: Dear Hiring Team at Coinbase India Services, I am writing to apply for the Software Engineer Intern role. As an MCA student at PES University with a CGPA of 8.48 and hands-on full-stack development experience, I am eager to contribute to building reliable web systems. During my internship at Sunflower Trip, I built a production-ready tours and travel management system using Angular, Node.js, Express, and MySQL, which was deployed for real customer bookings and featured role-based access control. Additionally, I delivered a Point of Sale system for a freelance client using Angular, C#, and MS SQL Server deployed on Azure, ensuring reliable transaction handling in a live business setting. In my personal projects, such as Zenvest, I developed a multi-service trading platform with JWT authentication, custom request validation, and API proxy caching, and built StaySphere with secure Passport.js session authentication and Express middleware. I bring strong foundational skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, React, SQL, and MongoDB, alongside experience deploying applications on AWS, Azure, Vercel, and Render. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my technical background aligns with your engineering goals.

My projects demonstrate my ability to implement secure authentication, API integrations, and robust backend workflows.
